operators.name: bce_with_logits_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise binary cross entropy with logits: max(x,0) - x*y + log(1+exp(-abs(x))) where x=y_pred element, y=y_true element.
No reduction. No weight, no pos_weight. Output shape matches broadcasted input shapes; here both are [128,1,1024,1024].
Inputs may be non-contiguous; operator must handle arbitrary strides or make contiguous copies internally.

Applies torch.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits with default reduction='mean'? No, explicit no reduction? Actually reference shows no reduction argument, default reduction='mean', but output shape is full [128,1,1024,1024], so reduction='none' must be inferred from output shape. Task contract says output shape equals input shape, so reduction='none'.
Inputs y_pred and y_true are float32 tensors on CUDA.
Returns tensor with same shape, dtype, device.
